notes.title: The Last Crystal Kickstarter is live!
notes.content:
Our Kickstarter is in full swing and we think that you’ll want to experience the adventure as much as we want to bring it to you.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/marc477/the-last-crystal-an-epic-co-op-adventure/?utm_source=steam 

We’ve designed a game where collaboration is key, making it a great way to game with your family, partner, or friends.

We made it this far and are ready for the next step. It’s the time to get some help and turn this project into reality. The fundraising will ALL be invested into quality and content for the game, and it allows you to get your hand on the game at a discount price and collect many cool rewards, so it’s a win-win for everyone.

We will indefinitely be grateful for any support!

Check the campaign out here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/marc477/the-last-crystal-an-epic-co-op-adventure/?utm_source=steam

Falling Flames Team

notes.title: The Last Crystal Kickstarter is launching soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The team has been working on this adventure game for more than 3 years, with the goal of making an adventure puzzle game that would focus primarily on co-op play.

Enjoy the demo? Much more content is coming! 

We are working hard to make the best game we can, and a Kickstarter will really help to push the quality and content of the project beyond its limits!

We will indefinitely be grateful if you support the Kickstarter campaign!

Here is the link to be notified when it is launched Tuesday on May 05:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/marc477/the-last-crystal-an-epic-co-op-adventure/?utm_source=steam

Falling Flames Team
